source_text.body:
Produce a 60-episode short drama from a script
A 5-person team uploaded a 40,000+ character script to a short-drama agent that handled character setup, storyboarding and scene rendering for a 60-episode series in 8 days.
·
Nov 15, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
During beta testing of ByteDance's Xiaoyunque short-drama Agent, Chuangyi Media uploaded a script of more than 40,000 characters for the series 万兽独尊. The agent set up the characters, broke the script into storyboards and rendered the scenes. It produced a "story blueprint" that creators could edit shot by shot, including prompts, character references and character images. The team stepped in to make tweaks at key points.
How it went
A 5-person team finished 60 episodes in 8 days. The series passed 100 million Douyin views within 4 days of release and ranked first on Hongguo's comic-drama chart. Flaws included long waits, model clipping and garbled text.
Worth knowing
Expect long waits, clipping and garbled on-screen text, so plan time to review and fix shots. The article also reports AI episodes costing roughly 500 to 1,000 yuan each.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
I have a script of about [number] characters for a short drama called [title]. Break it into [number] episodes, create a character sheet for each main character, and write a storyboard with scene descriptions for the first [number] episodes. Finish with a folder of character profiles, episode outlines, and scene-by-scene prompts I can feed into a video generator, and check with me before using any paid service.
Original source: https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_32829833
